lines.en: I shift sideways through the cold water.

lines.zh: 我宽大的身子挤过礁缝。
lines.en: My broad body squeezes through a reef gap.
I push forward along the seafloor.
I rise a little, then settle.

lines.zh: 我从深海的暗里游过去。
lines.en: I swim out of the deep's darkness.
I sway my body and the water parts.
I follow the edge of the trench.

lines.zh: 我一路掀起海底的细沙。
lines.en: I stir the fine sand as I go.
I turn slowly toward the light.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住一片海底。
lines.en: My shadow covers a patch of seafloor.

lines.zh: 我游得很沉，像一块石头。
lines.en: I move heavily, like a stone.

lines.zh: 我从冷水层的上面滑过。
lines.en: I glide above the cold water layer.
I hover above the reef.
I sink into the deeper dark.
I push against the current.
I circle a sunken log.

lines.zh: 我悬在暗水里，鳍几乎不摆。
lines.en: I hang in the dark water, fins barely moving.
I'm wide and hard to hide.
The seafloor is dark; it suits me.
My fins fan slowly.
I don't care for the taste of cold water.

lines.zh: 我背上的纹路一道一道。
lines.en: The ridges on my back run in lines.

lines.zh: 我沉在沙上，压出一个坑。
lines.en: I settle on the sand and press a hollow.
The light on the surface is far above.
I open my mouth slowly and close it.
It's quiet enough to hear myself.
I have nowhere to be.
What are you doing down here?
I'm twice as wide as you.
The deeper it gets, the better I feel.
My fins can press the current down.
Don't back into the deep.
Your boots are on the sand.
In the deep I swim broadside.
These are my waters.

lines.zh: 宽身子一偏，撞上了礁壁。
lines.en: My broad body veered into the reef wall.
I pull back, raising a layer of sand.
I roll half a turn and steady.
One of my fins isn't working right.
This wound makes me heavier.
I press into the sand and pause.
I turn slowly back to face you.

lines.zh: 水里什么声音都传得远。
lines.en: Every sound carries far in the water.
Drop it; I'll take it myself.
The smell of meat drifting in the water.
That one's too dry.
I never crawl up onto land.
Move back to the reef.
The blood smell is stronger than that.
Why hold it above the surface?
I'm waiting for it to sink.
The meat is too dry; I will not touch it.
We're jammed in the channel.
My body brushes your legs.
You can't pull back; the sand is soft.
That clouded the water.
I turn to face you.
You stepped on my tail fin.
I barely gave ground.
All the pressure in this water is mine.
There's another shadow in the deep.
It's heavier than I am.
Its ridges are deeper than mine.
We split one stretch of seafloor.

lines.zh: 它撞了我一下，就沉下去了。
lines.en: It bumped me once and sank away.
We never rise to the surface.
It left first; I didn't follow.
This water is wide enough.
We slowly drifted apart.

lines.zh: 我含在嘴里，尝到铁锈味。
lines.en: I hold it in my mouth and taste rust.
Too hard; I push it along.
What sinks to the bottom is mine.
It fell from a boat.
That's not even a mouthful.
I lift it slowly.

lines.zh: 我三格宽的身子，压着海底。
lines.en: Three blocks wide, I press the seabed.
I let go and let it sink.
I lift my head that way.
That way lies the shallows.
I'm better suited to this than you.
I'm working my way up.
You stand out in this water.

lines.zh: 我的身体已经转过去了。
lines.en: My body has already turned.
Your breaths grew short; I heard.
You've backed against the reef wall.
I stay at your rear flank.
Wherever you turn, I follow.
Your bootprints stay in the sand.
I'm beneath you the whole time.

lines.zh: 你的心跳在深水里太清楚。
lines.en: Your heartbeat is too clear in deep water.

lines.zh: 你换了三次路，我都跟着。
lines.en: You changed course three times; I followed.
This water leads to only one place.
Your lamp is useless in the deep.

lines.zh: 你停住了，我也不再推水。
lines.en: You stopped; I stop pushing water.
I slam my whole body into you.
That carried the weight of the water.
You're knocked into a tumble.
You pull back and I press on.
I press you down into the sand.
Your weapon slipped from your hand.

lines.zh: 水让我这一下慢了一拍。
lines.en: The water slowed that blow by a beat.
I draw back and realign myself.
I rise out of the deep water.
The sea has gone darker all at once.
My shadow lies across the seabed.
Cold water isn't cold to me.
I swim one test circuit.
The reef makes way for my bulk.

lines.zh: 水压变了，我知道我到了。
lines.en: The pressure changed; I know I've arrived.
The seafloor sand lifts.
I sink slowly and settle.

lines.zh: 我从高处落进水里，砸出大浪。
lines.en: I hit the water from above and make a big wave.

lines.zh: 在水里竟然还能被呛住。
lines.en: Somehow I can still choke, even in water.

lines.zh: 水底炸开，冲击把我推远。
lines.en: The bottom bursts and the shock shoves me away.
An arrow lodges in my flank.

lines.zh: 光在水里炸开，我看不清。
lines.en: Light bursts underwater and I can't see.

lines.zh: 这片海底没什么可吃的。
lines.en: There's little to eat on this seafloor.

lines.zh: 雷进了水里，我整条都麻。
lines.en: Lightning enters the water and numbs me.
There's no water here to hold me up.
